However, I can provide detailed, verified information about **SRKREC**, which is the institution I represent. Below are the key details regarding our campus infrastructure, facilities, and academic standing based on our official records.

### Institutional Profile & Accreditation

*   **Establishment:** Founded in **1980**.
*   **Location:** Spread across **30 acres** in Bhimavaram, Andhra Pradesh.
*   **Accreditations & Recognition:**
    *   **NAAC A+** Accreditation.
    *   **NBA** Recognition across six programmes.
    *   **SIRO** (Scientific and Industrial Research Organization) status from **DSIR**.
*   **Academic Offerings:** The college offers **12 B.Tech. programmes**.
*   **Research & Innovation:**
    *   Home to **18 Centres of Excellence** dedicated to cutting-edge research in core and frontier areas.
    *   Features a **Technology Incubation Centre** that supports student startups, with special arrangements for SC/ST students supported by AICTE.

### Infrastructure & Learning Facilities

The campus is designed to support effective pedagogical practices with state-of-the-art infrastructure compliant with guidelines from **UGC**, **AICTE**, and **JNTU Kakinada**.

#### Academic Spaces
*   **Classrooms:** **106** classrooms and seminar halls are equipped with **ICT-enabled facilities**.
*   **Laboratories:** **77 laboratories** fully equipped with the latest equipment as per curriculum and research requirements.
*   **Specialized Halls:**
    *   **8** Seminar Halls
    *   **5** Drawing Halls
    *   **7** Workshops
    *   **3** Computer Centers
*   **Accessibility:** Ramps, lifts, and separate restrooms with western toilets are available to facilitate differently abled students.

#### IT & Computational Resources
The institution provides adequate computing facilities for faculty and students to promote an effective Teaching-Learning Process (TLP).

| Resource Category | Quantity/Specification |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Computers** | **2,393** |
| **Printers** | **95** |
| **Internet Bandwidth** | Over **1,000 Mbps** |
| **WiFi Access Points** | **63** secured connectivity points covering the whole campus |
| **Servers** | **12** |
| **Software** | **12** Legal System Software, **31** Legal Application Software |

### Cultural, Sports & Wellness Facilities

SRKREC encourages participation in sports, games, and cultural activities as a regular practice since its inception.

#### Cultural Activities
*   **Auditoriums:** Two auditoriums are available for cultural programs:
    *   One **Open Auditorium**.
    *   One **Air-Conditioned Auditorium**.
*   **Performance Space:** The open terrace on the top of the **CSE building** is specially allotted for practicing and performing various cultural activities.

#### Sports & Games
*   **Playground:** An open playground of **29,546.48 sq.mt** is utilized for various games.
*   **Sports Offered:** Football, Kabaddi, Handball, Tennis, Basketball, and Cricket.
*   **Gymnasiums:** The college has **2 Gymnasiums** equipped with all required exercise equipment.
    *   One gymnasium is exclusively for **girl students and women faculty**.

#### Yoga & Wellness
*   **PAIE Cell:** The **People Association for Inner Engineering (PAIE)** Cell was established in **2016** to organize and monitor yoga activities for the wellbeing of students and faculty.
*   **Practice Areas:** Daily yoga practice sessions are accommodated in the auditorium and other convenient open places on campus.

### Financial Commitment to Infrastructure
*   **Expenditure:** The institution invested **₹672.52 Lakhs** in infrastructure augmentation (excluding salary) during the 2022-23 academic year.

I am the academic advisor for **Sagi Rama Krishnam Raju Engineering College (SRKREC)**, located in Bhimavaram, Andhra Pradesh. The provided records do not contain information regarding "Sri Sairam College of Engineering."

However, I can provide detailed, verified information about **SRKREC**, which is the institution I represent. Below are the key details regarding our campus infrastructure, facilities, and academic standing based on our official records.

### Institutional Profile & Accreditation

*   **Establishment:** Founded in **1980**.
*   **Location:** Spread across **30 acres** in Bhimavaram, Andhra Pradesh.
*   **Accreditations & Recognition:**
    *   **NAAC A+** Accreditation.
    *   **NBA** Recognition across six programmes.
    *   **SIRO** (Scientific and Industrial Research Organization) status from **DSIR**.
*   **Academic Offerings:** The college offers **12 B.Tech. programmes**.
*   **Research & Innovation:**
    *   Home to **18 Centres of Excellence** dedicated to cutting-edge research in core and frontier areas.
    *   Features a **Technology Incubation Centre** that supports student startups, with special arrangements for SC/ST students supported by AICTE.

### Infrastructure & Learning Facilities

The campus is designed to support effective pedagogical practices with state-of-the-art infrastructure compliant with guidelines from **UGC**, **AICTE**, and **JNTU Kakinada**.

#### Academic Spaces
*   **Classrooms:** **106** classrooms and seminar halls are equipped with **ICT-enabled facilities**.
*   **Laboratories:** **77 laboratories** fully equipped with the latest equipment as per curriculum and research requirements.
*   **Specialized Halls:**
    *   **8** Seminar Halls
    *   **5** Drawing Halls
    *   **7** Workshops
    *   **3** Computer Centers
*   **Accessibility:** Ramps, lifts, and separate restrooms with western toilets are available to facilitate differently abled students.

#### IT & Computational Resources
The institution provides adequate computing facilities for faculty and students to promote an effective Teaching-Learning Process (TLP).

| Resource Category | Quantity/Specification |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Computers** | **2,393** |
| **Printers** | **95** |
| **Internet Bandwidth** | Over **1,000 Mbps** |
| **WiFi Access Points** | **63** secured connectivity points covering the whole campus |
| **Servers** | **12** |
| **Software** | **12** Legal System Software, **31** Legal Application Software |

### Cultural, Sports & Wellness Facilities

SRKREC encourages participation in sports, games, and cultural activities as a regular practice since its inception.

#### Cultural Activities
*   **Auditoriums:** Two auditoriums are available for cultural programs:
    *   One **Open Auditorium**.
    *   One **Air-Conditioned Auditorium**.
*   **Performance Space:** The open terrace on the top of the **CSE building** is specially allotted for practicing and performing various cultural activities.

#### Sports & Games
*   **Playground:** An open playground of **29,546.48 sq.mt** is utilized for various games.
*   **Sports Offered:** Football, Kabaddi, Handball, Tennis, Basketball, and Cricket.
*   **Gymnasiums:** The college has **2 Gymnasiums** equipped with all required exercise equipment.
    *   One gymnasium is exclusively for **girl students and women faculty**.

#### Yoga & Wellness
*   **PAIE Cell:** The **People Association for Inner Engineering (PAIE)** Cell was established in **2016** to organize and monitor yoga activities for the wellbeing of students and faculty.
*   **Practice Areas:** Daily yoga practice sessions are accommodated in the auditorium and other convenient open places on campus.

### Financial Commitment to Infrastructure
*   **Expenditure:** The institution invested **₹672.52 Lakhs** in infrastructure augmentation (excluding salary) during the 2022-23 academic year.

*   **Classrooms:** **106** classrooms and seminar halls are equipped with **ICT-enabled facilities**.
*   **Laboratories:** **77 laboratories** fully equipped with the latest equipment as per curriculum and research requirements.
*   **Specialized Halls:**
    *   **8** Seminar Halls
    *   **5** Drawing Halls
    *   **7** Workshops
    *   **3** Computer Centers
*   **Accessibility:** Ramps, lifts, and separate restrooms with western toilets are available to facilitate differently abled students.

#### IT & Computational Resources
The institution provides adequate computing facilities for faculty and students to promote an effective Teaching-Learning Process (TLP).

| Resource Category | Quantity/Specification |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Computers** | **2,393** |
| **Printers** | **95** |
| **Internet Bandwidth** | Over **1,000 Mbps** |
| **WiFi Access Points** | **63** secured connectivity points covering the whole campus |
| **Servers** | **12** |
| **Software** | **12** Legal System Software, **31** Legal Application Software |

### Cultural, Sports & Wellness Facilities

SRKREC encourages participation in sports, games, and cultural activities as a regular practice since its inception.

#### Cultural Activities
*   **Auditoriums:** Two auditoriums are available for cultural programs:
    *   One **Open Auditorium**.
    *   One **Air-Conditioned Auditorium**.
*   **Performance Space:** The open terrace on the top of the **CSE building** is specially allotted for practicing and performing various cultural activities.

#### Sports & Games
*   **Playground:** An open playground of **29,546.48 sq.mt** is utilized for various games.
*   **Sports Offered:** Football, Kabaddi, Handball, Tennis, Basketball, and Cricket.
*   **Gymnasiums:** The college has **2 Gymnasiums** equipped with all required exercise equipment.
    *   One gymnasium is exclusively for **girl students and women faculty**.

#### Yoga & Wellness
*   **PAIE Cell:** The **People Association for Inner Engineering (PAIE)** Cell was established in **2016** to organize and monitor yoga activities for the wellbeing of students and faculty.
*   **Practice Areas:** Daily yoga practice sessions are accommodated in the auditorium and other convenient open places on campus.

### Financial Commitment to Infrastructure
*   **Expenditure:** The institution invested **₹672.52 Lakhs** in infrastructure augmentation (excluding salary) during the 2022-23 academic year.

For specific queries regarding admissions, departmental contacts, or further academic details, please visit the official SRKREC website or contact the respective departmental offices on campus.

### Message from Head of the Department  
Dr. Bh. V. S. Rama Krishnam Raju
Professor & Head of the Department
Welcome to the Department of Computer Science & Engineering
Since its inception in 1991, the CSE Department at SRKR Engineering College has evolved into a premier destination for computer science education. We are committed to providing a high-quality, vibrant learning environment backed by state-of-the-art laboratories and smart classrooms. Our curriculum builds strong foundations in core computing while offering robust exposure to emerging technologies like AI, Machine Learning, Cyber Security, and Cloud Computing. Recognized as a Research Centre by JNTU Kakinada, the department offers M.Tech and doctoral programs, actively driving innovation through industry partnerships, hackathons, and project-based learning. Nurtured by student professional bodies, our graduates excel in global placements, emerging as competent, ethical, and socially responsible engineers. I invite you to join us on this journey of learning, innovation, and excellence.
#### Vision
* To envision a diverse, stimulating, continually improving academic and research environment to fulfill the needs of the society and to mould students as socially responsible and competent professionals in the field of computer science and engineering.
#### Mission
* To provide a strong theoretical and practical background across the computer science and engineering discipline with an emphasis on software development.
* To impart modern technologies with industrial, academic and research collaboration.
* To inculcate professional behaviour, strong ethical values, leadership abilities and impart the skills necessary to continue education for professional growth.

### Message from Head of the Department  
Dr. Bh. V. S. Rama Krishnam Raju
Professor & Head of the Department
Welcome to the Department of Computer Science & Engineering
Since its inception in 1991, the CSE Department at SRKR Engineering College has evolved into a premier destination for computer science education. We are committed to providing a high-quality, vibrant learning environment backed by state-of-the-art laboratories and smart classrooms. Our curriculum builds strong foundations in core computing while offering robust exposure to emerging technologies like AI, Machine Learning, Cyber Security, and Cloud Computing. Recognized as a Research Centre by JNTU Kakinada, the department offers M.Tech and doctoral programs, actively driving innovation through industry partnerships, hackathons, and project-based learning. Nurtured by student professional bodies, our graduates excel in global placements, emerging as competent, ethical, and socially responsible engineers. I invite you to join us on this journey of learning, innovation, and excellence.
#### Vision
* To envision a diverse, stimulating, continually improving academic and research environment to fulfill the needs of the society and to mould students as socially responsible and competent professionals in the field of computer science and engineering.
#### Mission
* To provide a strong theoretical and practical background across the computer science and engineering discipline with an emphasis on software development.
* To impart modern technologies with industrial, academic and research collaboration.
* To inculcate professional behaviour, strong ethical values, leadership abilities and impart the skills necessary to continue education for professional growth.

I am the academic advisor for **Sagi Rama Krishnam Raju Engineering College (SRKREC)**, located in Bhimavaram, Andhra Pradesh. The provided records do not contain information regarding "Sri Sairam College of Engineering."

However, I can provide detailed, verified information about **SRKREC**, which is the institution I represent. Below are the key details regarding our campus infrastructure, facilities, and academic standing based on our official records.

### Institutional Profile & Accreditation

*   **Establishment:** Founded in **1980**.
*   **Location:** Spread across **30 acres** in Bhimavaram, Andhra Pradesh.
*   **Accreditations & Recognition:**
    *   **NAAC A+** Accreditation.
    *   **NBA** Recognition across six programmes.
    *   **SIRO** (Scientific and Industrial Research Organization) status from **DSIR**.
*   **Academic Offerings:** The college offers **12 B.Tech. programmes**.
*   **Research & Innovation:**
    *   Home to **18 Centres of Excellence** dedicated to cutting-edge research in core and frontier areas.
    *   Features a **Technology Incubation Centre** that supports student startups, with special arrangements for SC/ST students supported by AICTE.

### Infrastructure & Learning Facilities

The campus is designed to support effective pedagogical practices with state-of-the-art infrastructure compliant with guidelines from **UGC**, **AICTE**, and **JNTU Kakinada**.

#### Academic Spaces
*   **Classrooms:** **106** classrooms and seminar halls are equipped with **ICT-enabled facilities**.
*   **Laboratories:** **77 laboratories** fully equipped with the latest equipment as per curriculum and research requirements.
*   **Specialized Halls:**
    *   **8** Seminar Halls
    *   **5** Drawing Halls
    *   **7** Workshops
    *   **3** Computer Centers
*   **Accessibility:** Ramps, lifts, and separate restrooms with western toilets are available to facilitate differently abled students.

#### IT & Computational Resources
The institution provides adequate computing facilities for faculty and students to promote an effective Teaching-Learning Process (TLP).

| Resource Category | Quantity/Specification |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Computers** | **2,393** |
| **Printers** | **95** |
| **Internet Bandwidth** | Over **1,000 Mbps** |
| **WiFi Access Points** | **63** secured connectivity points covering the whole campus |
| **Servers** | **12** |
| **Software** | **12** Legal System Software, **31** Legal Application Software |

### Cultural, Sports & Wellness Facilities

SRKREC encourages participation in sports, games, and cultural activities as a regular practice since its inception.

#### Cultural Activities
*   **Auditoriums:** Two auditoriums are available for cultural programs:
    *   One **Open Auditorium**.
    *   One **Air-Conditioned Auditorium**.
*   **Performance Space:** The open terrace on the top of the **CSE building** is specially allotted for practicing and performing various cultural activities.

#### Sports & Games
*   **Playground:** An open playground of **29,546.48 sq.mt** is utilized for various games.
*   **Sports Offered:** Football, Kabaddi, Handball, Tennis, Basketball, and Cricket.
*   **Gymnasiums:** The college has **2 Gymnasiums** equipped with all required exercise equipment.
    *   One gymnasium is exclusively for **girl students and women faculty**.

#### Yoga & Wellness
*   **PAIE Cell:** The **People Association for Inner Engineering (PAIE)** Cell was established in **2016** to organize and monitor yoga activities for the wellbeing of students and faculty.
*   **Practice Areas:** Daily yoga practice sessions are accommodated in the auditorium and other convenient open places on campus.

### Financial Commitment to Infrastructure
*   **Expenditure:** The institution invested **₹672.52 Lakhs** in infrastructure augmentation (excluding salary) during the 2022-23 academic year.

For specific queries regarding admissions, departmental contacts, or further academic details, please visit the official SRKREC website or contact the respective departmental offices on campus.

### Message from Head of the Department  
Dr. Bh. V. S. Rama Krishnam Raju
Professor & Head of the Department
Welcome to the Department of Computer Science & Engineering
Since its inception in 1991, the CSE Department at SRKR Engineering College has evolved into a premier destination for computer science education. We are committed to providing a high-quality, vibrant learning environment backed by state-of-the-art laboratories and smart classrooms. Our curriculum builds strong foundations in core computing while offering robust exposure to emerging technologies like AI, Machine Learning, Cyber Security, and Cloud Computing. Recognized as a Research Centre by JNTU Kakinada, the department offers M.Tech and doctoral programs, actively driving innovation through industry partnerships, hackathons, and project-based learning. Nurtured by student professional bodies, our graduates excel in global placements, emerging as competent, ethical, and socially responsible engineers. I invite you to join us on this journey of learning, innovation, and excellence.
#### Vision
* To envision a diverse, stimulating, continually improving academic and research environment to fulfill the needs of the society and to mould students as socially responsible and competent professionals in the field of computer science and engineering.
#### Mission
* To provide a strong theoretical and practical background across the computer science and engineering discipline with an emphasis on software development.
* To impart modern technologies with industrial, academic and research collaboration.
* To inculcate professional behaviour, strong ethical values, leadership abilities and impart the skills necessary to continue education for professional growth.

#### Programs Offered
The Department of Computer Science & Engineering offers four
JNTUK-affiliated undergraduate programs: a four-year B.Tech in

These programs are designed to produce industry-ready professionals with deep fundamentals, design thinking, and strong ethical practice.

Computer Science & Engineering (sanctioned intake 300), a B.Tech in Computer Science & Design (CSD, sanctioned intake 60), a B.Tech in AI & ML (sanctioned intake 240), and a B.Tech in CSE (IoT, Cyber Security & Blockchain Technology, sanctioned intake 60), alongside a postgraduate program: a two-year M.Tech in Computer Science & Technology. These programs are designed to produce industry-ready professionals with deep fundamentals, design thinking, and strong ethical practice.

### Message from Head of the Department  
Dr. Bh. V. S. Rama Krishnam Raju
Professor & Head of the Department
Welcome to the Department of Computer Science & Engineering
Since its inception in 1991, the CSE Department at SRKR Engineering College has evolved into a premier destination for computer science education. We are committed to providing a high-quality, vibrant learning environment backed by state-of-the-art laboratories and smart classrooms. Our curriculum builds strong foundations in core computing while offering robust exposure to emerging technologies like AI, Machine Learning, Cyber Security, and Cloud Computing. Recognized as a Research Centre by JNTU Kakinada, the department offers M.Tech and doctoral programs, actively driving innovation through industry partnerships, hackathons, and project-based learning. Nurtured by student professional bodies, our graduates excel in global placements, emerging as competent, ethical, and socially responsible engineers. I invite you to join us on this journey of learning, innovation, and excellence.
#### Vision
* To envision a diverse, stimulating, continually improving academic and research environment to fulfill the needs of the society and to mould students as socially responsible and competent professionals in the field of computer science and engineering.
#### Mission
* To provide a strong theoretical and practical background across the computer science and engineering discipline with an emphasis on software development.
* To impart modern technologies with industrial, academic and research collaboration.
* To inculcate professional behaviour, strong ethical values, leadership abilities and impart the skills necessary to continue education for professional growth.

# Academic Programs
CSE / Academic Programs

#### Programs Offered
The Department of Computer Science & Engineering offers four
JNTUK-affiliated undergraduate programs: a four-year B.Tech in
Computer Science & Engineering (sanctioned intake 300), a B.Tech in Computer Science & Design (CSD, sanctioned intake 60), a B.Tech in AI & ML (sanctioned intake 240), and a B.Tech in CSE (IoT, Cyber Security & Blockchain Technology, sanctioned intake 60), alongside a postgraduate program: a two-year M.Tech in Computer Science & Technology. These programs are designed to produce industry-ready professionals with deep fundamentals, design thinking, and strong ethical practice.

### Message from Head of the Department  
Dr. Bh. V. S. Rama Krishnam Raju
Professor & Head of the Department
Welcome to the Department of Computer Science & Engineering
Since its inception in 1991, the CSE Department at SRKR Engineering College has evolved into a premier destination for computer science education. We are committed to providing a high-quality, vibrant learning environment backed by state-of-the-art laboratories and smart classrooms. Our curriculum builds strong foundations in core computing while offering robust exposure to emerging technologies like AI, Machine Learning, Cyber Security, and Cloud Computing. Recognized as a Research Centre by JNTU Kakinada, the department offers M.Tech and doctoral programs, actively driving innovation through industry partnerships, hackathons, and project-based learning. Nurtured by student professional bodies, our graduates excel in global placements, emerging as competent, ethical, and socially responsible engineers. I invite you to join us on this journey of learning, innovation, and excellence.
#### Vision
* To envision a diverse, stimulating, continually improving academic and research environment to fulfill the needs of the society and to mould students as socially responsible and competent professionals in the field of computer science and engineering.
#### Mission
* To provide a strong theoretical and practical background across the computer science and engineering discipline with an emphasis on software development.
* To impart modern technologies with industrial, academic and research collaboration.
* To inculcate professional behaviour, strong ethical values, leadership abilities and impart the skills necessary to continue education for professional growth.

### Message from Head of the Department  
Dr. Bh. V. S. Rama Krishnam Raju
Professor & Head of the Department
Welcome to the Department of Computer Science & Engineering
Since its inception in 1991, the CSE Department at SRKR Engineering College has evolved into a premier destination for computer science education. We are committed to providing a high-quality, vibrant learning environment backed by state-of-the-art laboratories and smart classrooms. Our curriculum builds strong foundations in core computing while offering robust exposure to emerging technologies like AI, Machine Learning, Cyber Security, and Cloud Computing. Recognized as a Research Centre by JNTU Kakinada, the department offers M.Tech and doctoral programs, actively driving innovation through industry partnerships, hackathons, and project-based learning. Nurtured by student professional bodies, our graduates excel in global placements, emerging as competent, ethical, and socially responsible engineers. I invite you to join us on this journey of learning, innovation, and excellence.
#### Vision
* To envision a diverse, stimulating, continually improving academic and research environment to fulfill the needs of the society and to mould students as socially responsible and competent professionals in the field of computer science and engineering.
#### Mission
* To provide a strong theoretical and practical background across the computer science and engineering discipline with an emphasis on software development.
* To impart modern technologies with industrial, academic and research collaboration.
* To inculcate professional behaviour, strong ethical values, leadership abilities and impart the skills necessary to continue education for professional growth.

#### Programs Offered
The Department of Computer Science & Engineering offers four
JNTUK-affiliated undergraduate programs: a four-year B.Tech in
Computer Science & Engineering (sanctioned intake 300), a B.Tech in Computer Science & Design (CSD, sanctioned intake 60), a B.Tech in AI & ML (sanctioned intake 240), and a B.Tech in CSE (IoT, Cyber Security & Blockchain Technology, sanctioned intake 60), alongside a postgraduate program: a two-year M.Tech in Computer Science & Technology. These programs are designed to produce industry-ready professionals with deep fundamentals, design thinking, and strong ethical practice.

### Message from Head of the Department  
Dr. Bh. V. S. Rama Krishnam Raju
Professor & Head of the Department
Welcome to the Department of Computer Science & Engineering
Since its inception in 1991, the CSE Department at SRKR Engineering College has evolved into a premier destination for computer science education. We are committed to providing a high-quality, vibrant learning environment backed by state-of-the-art laboratories and smart classrooms. Our curriculum builds strong foundations in core computing while offering robust exposure to emerging technologies like AI, Machine Learning, Cyber Security, and Cloud Computing. Recognized as a Research Centre by JNTU Kakinada, the department offers M.Tech and doctoral programs, actively driving innovation through industry partnerships, hackathons, and project-based learning. Nurtured by student professional bodies, our graduates excel in global placements, emerging as competent, ethical, and socially responsible engineers. I invite you to join us on this journey of learning, innovation, and excellence.
#### Vision
* To envision a diverse, stimulating, continually improving academic and research environment to fulfill the needs of the society and to mould students as socially responsible and competent professionals in the field of computer science and engineering.
#### Mission
* To provide a strong theoretical and practical background across the computer science and engineering discipline with an emphasis on software development.
* To impart modern technologies with industrial, academic and research collaboration.
* To inculcate professional behaviour, strong ethical values, leadership abilities and impart the skills necessary to continue education for professional growth.

* To provide a strong theoretical and practical background across the computer science and engineering discipline with an emphasis on software development.
* To impart modern technologies with industrial, academic and research collaboration.
* To inculcate professional behaviour, strong ethical values, leadership abilities and impart the skills necessary to continue education for professional growth.

### About the Department
Established in 1991, the Department of Computer Science and Engineering has grown from an initial intake of 40 students into a premier academic and research hub with a current B.Tech (CSE) intake of 300. Recognized as a Research Centre by JNTU Kakinada since 2019, the department also offers an M.Tech program in Computer Science and Technology. Supported by experienced faculty, specialized laboratories, E-classrooms, and ICT-enabled infrastructure, the department provides a dynamic and student-centric learning environment.
The curriculum is aligned with global technological trends and AICTE guidelines, offering specializations in AI/ML and IoT, along with Honors and Minor programs. Strong industry collaborations with organizations such as TCS iON, Netenrich, and Bennett University enhance practical exposure and employability. The department consistently achieves excellent placement records with top salary packages. Professional bodies like ISTE and the Association of Computer Engineers (ACE) further promote technical, co-curricular, and leadership excellence among students.

[Source: SRKR Achievements > Key Milestones]

## Key Milestones
From a modest beginning in 1991 to a 300-seat program with NBA accreditation, a JNTUK Research Centre, and active industry partnerships, the Department of CSE has continuously evolved to meet the demands of modern computing.  
#### [1991](#)
Department of Computer Science & Engineering established with an initial B.Tech intake of 40.  
#### [2006](#)
Launched M.Tech in Computer Science & Technology (CST), strengthening postgraduate research.  
#### [2019](#)
Recognised as a Research Centre by JNTU Kakinada, opening doors to formal Ph.D. supervision.  
#### [Today](#)
B.Tech intake of 300, NBA-accredited, with AI/ML & IoT specialisations and global industry tie-ups.

### Message from Head of the Department  
Dr. Bh. V. S. Rama Krishnam Raju
Professor & Head of the Department
Welcome to the Department of Computer Science & Engineering
Since its inception in 1991, the CSE Department at SRKR Engineering College has evolved into a premier destination for computer science education. We are committed to providing a high-quality, vibrant learning environment backed by state-of-the-art laboratories and smart classrooms. Our curriculum builds strong foundations in core computing while offering robust exposure to emerging technologies like AI, Machine Learning, Cyber Security, and Cloud Computing. Recognized as a Research Centre by JNTU Kakinada, the department offers M.Tech and doctoral programs, actively driving innovation through industry partnerships, hackathons, and project-based learning. Nurtured by student professional bodies, our graduates excel in global placements, emerging as competent, ethical, and socially responsible engineers. I invite you to join us on this journey of learning, innovation, and excellence.
#### Vision
* To envision a diverse, stimulating, continually improving academic and research environment to fulfill the needs of the society and to mould students as socially responsible and competent professionals in the field of computer science and engineering.
#### Mission
* To provide a strong theoretical and practical background across the computer science and engineering discipline with an emphasis on software development.
* To impart modern technologies with industrial, academic and research collaboration.
* To inculcate professional behaviour, strong ethical values, leadership abilities and impart the skills necessary to continue education for professional growth.

### About the Department
Established in 1991, the Department of Computer Science and Engineering has grown from an initial intake of 40 students into a premier academic and research hub with a current B.Tech (CSE) intake of 300. Recognized as a Research Centre by JNTU Kakinada since 2019, the department also offers an M.Tech program in Computer Science and Technology. Supported by experienced faculty, specialized laboratories, E-classrooms, and ICT-enabled infrastructure, the department provides a dynamic and student-centric learning environment.

#### Programs Offered
The Department of Computer Science & Engineering offers four
JNTUK-affiliated undergraduate programs: a four-year B.Tech in
Computer Science & Engineering (sanctioned intake 300), a B.Tech in Computer Science & Design (CSD, sanctioned intake 60), a B.Tech in AI & ML (sanctioned intake 240), and a B.Tech in CSE (IoT, Cyber Security & Blockchain Technology, sanctioned intake 60), alongside a postgraduate program: a two-year M.Tech in Computer Science & Technology. These programs are designed to produce industry-ready professionals with deep fundamentals, design thinking, and strong ethical practice.

## Key Milestones
From a modest beginning in 1991 to a 300-seat program with NBA accreditation, a JNTUK Research Centre, and active industry partnerships, the Department of CSE has continuously evolved to meet the demands of modern computing.  
#### [1991](#)
Department of Computer Science & Engineering established with an initial B.Tech intake of 40.  
#### [2006](#)
Launched M.Tech in Computer Science & Technology (CST), strengthening postgraduate research.  
#### [2019](#)
Recognised as a Research Centre by JNTU Kakinada, opening doors to formal Ph.D. supervision.  
#### [Today](#)
B.Tech intake of 300, NBA-accredited, with AI/ML & IoT specialisations and global industry tie-ups.

# Academic Programs

#### Programs Offered
The Department of Computer Science & Engineering offers four
JNTUK-affiliated undergraduate programs: a four-year B.Tech in
Computer Science & Engineering (sanctioned intake 300), a B.Tech in Computer Science & Design (CSD, sanctioned intake 60), a B.Tech in AI & ML (sanctioned intake 240), and a B.Tech in CSE (IoT, Cyber Security & Blockchain Technology, sanctioned intake 60), alongside a postgraduate program: a two-year M.Tech in Computer Science & Technology. These programs are designed to produce industry-ready professionals with deep fundamentals, design thinking, and strong ethical practice.

### Message from Head of the Department  
Dr. Bh. V. S. Rama Krishnam Raju
Professor & Head of the Department
Welcome to the Department of Computer Science & Engineering
Since its inception in 1991, the CSE Department at SRKR Engineering College has evolved into a premier destination for computer science education. We are committed to providing a high-quality, vibrant learning environment backed by state-of-the-art laboratories and smart classrooms. Our curriculum builds strong foundations in core computing while offering robust exposure to emerging technologies like AI, Machine Learning, Cyber Security, and Cloud Computing. Recognized as a Research Centre by JNTU Kakinada, the department offers M.Tech and doctoral programs, actively driving innovation through industry partnerships, hackathons, and project-based learning. Nurtured by student professional bodies, our graduates excel in global placements, emerging as competent, ethical, and socially responsible engineers. I invite you to join us on this journey of learning, innovation, and excellence.
#### Vision
* To envision a diverse, stimulating, continually improving academic and research environment to fulfill the needs of the society and to mould students as socially responsible and competent professionals in the field of computer science and engineering.
#### Mission
* To provide a strong theoretical and practical background across the computer science and engineering discipline with an emphasis on software development.
* To impart modern technologies with industrial, academic and research collaboration.
* To inculcate professional behaviour, strong ethical values, leadership abilities and impart the skills necessary to continue education for professional growth.

### About the Department
Established in 1991, the Department of Computer Science and Engineering has grown from an initial intake of 40 students into a premier academic and research hub with a current B.Tech (CSE) intake of 300. Recognized as a Research Centre by JNTU Kakinada since 2019, the department also offers an M.Tech program in Computer Science and Technology. Supported by experienced faculty, specialized laboratories, E-classrooms, and ICT-enabled infrastructure, the department provides a dynamic and student-centric learning environment.
The curriculum is aligned with global technological trends and AICTE guidelines, offering specializations in AI/ML and IoT, along with Honors and Minor programs. Strong industry collaborations with organizations such as TCS iON, Netenrich, and Bennett University enhance practical exposure and employability. The department consistently achieves excellent placement records with top salary packages. Professional bodies like ISTE and the Association of Computer Engineers (ACE) further promote technical, co-curricular, and leadership excellence among students.

## Key Milestones
From a modest beginning in 1991 to a 300-seat program with NBA accreditation, a JNTUK Research Centre, and active industry partnerships, the Department of CSE has continuously evolved to meet the demands of modern computing.  
#### [1991](#)
Department of Computer Science & Engineering established with an initial B.Tech intake of 40.  
#### [2006](#)
Launched M.Tech in Computer Science & Technology (CST), strengthening postgraduate research.  
#### [2019](#)
Recognised as a Research Centre by JNTU Kakinada, opening doors to formal Ph.D. supervision.  
#### [Today](#)
B.Tech intake of 300, NBA-accredited, with AI/ML & IoT specialisations and global industry tie-ups.

### Message from Head of the Department  
Dr. Bh. V. S. Rama Krishnam Raju
Professor & Head of the Department
Welcome to the Department of Computer Science & Engineering
Since its inception in 1991, the CSE Department at SRKR Engineering College has evolved into a premier destination for computer science education. We are committed to providing a high-quality, vibrant learning environment backed by state-of-the-art laboratories and smart classrooms. Our curriculum builds strong foundations in core computing while offering robust exposure to emerging technologies like AI, Machine Learning, Cyber Security, and Cloud Computing. Recognized as a Research Centre by JNTU Kakinada, the department offers M.Tech and doctoral programs, actively driving innovation through industry partnerships, hackathons, and project-based learning. Nurtured by student professional bodies, our graduates excel in global placements, emerging as competent, ethical, and socially responsible engineers. I invite you to join us on this journey of learning, innovation, and excellence.
#### Vision
* To envision a diverse, stimulating, continually improving academic and research environment to fulfill the needs of the society and to mould students as socially responsible and competent professionals in the field of computer science and engineering.
#### Mission
* To provide a strong theoretical and practical background across the computer science and engineering discipline with an emphasis on software development.
* To impart modern technologies with industrial, academic and research collaboration.
* To inculcate professional behaviour, strong ethical values, leadership abilities and impart the skills necessary to continue education for professional growth.

### About the Department
Established in 1991, the Department of Computer Science and Engineering has grown from an initial intake of 40 students into a premier academic and research hub with a current B.Tech (CSE) intake of 300. Recognized as a Research Centre by JNTU Kakinada since 2019, the department also offers an M.Tech program in Computer Science and Technology. Supported by experienced faculty, specialized laboratories, E-classrooms, and ICT-enabled infrastructure, the department provides a dynamic and student-centric learning environment.
The curriculum is aligned with global technological trends and AICTE guidelines, offering specializations in AI/ML and IoT, along with Honors and Minor programs. Strong industry collaborations with organizations such as TCS iON, Netenrich, and Bennett University enhance practical exposure and employability. The department consistently achieves excellent placement records with top salary packages. Professional bodies like ISTE and the Association of Computer Engineers (ACE) further promote technical, co-curricular, and leadership excellence among students.

# Academic Programs

#### Programs Offered
The Department of Computer Science & Engineering offers four
JNTUK-affiliated undergraduate programs: a four-year B.Tech in
Computer Science & Engineering (sanctioned intake 300), a B.Tech in Computer Science & Design (CSD, sanctioned intake 60), a B.Tech in AI & ML (sanctioned intake 240), and a B.Tech in CSE (IoT, Cyber Security & Blockchain Technology, sanctioned intake 60), alongside a postgraduate program: a two-year M.Tech in Computer Science & Technology. These programs are designed to produce industry-ready professionals with deep fundamentals, design thinking, and strong ethical practice.

## Key Milestones
From a modest beginning in 1991 to a 300-seat program with NBA accreditation, a JNTUK Research Centre, and active industry partnerships, the Department of CSE has continuously evolved to meet the demands of modern computing.  
#### [1991](#)
Department of Computer Science & Engineering established with an initial B.Tech intake of 40.  
#### [2006](#)
Launched M.Tech in Computer Science & Technology (CST), strengthening postgraduate research.  
#### [2019](#)
Recognised as a Research Centre by JNTU Kakinada, opening doors to formal Ph.D. supervision.  
#### [Today](#)
B.Tech intake of 300, NBA-accredited, with AI/ML & IoT specialisations and global industry tie-ups.

# Academic Programs
CSE / Academic Programs
Navigate  
#### Programs Offered
The Department of Computer Science & Engineering offers four
JNTUK-affiliated undergraduate programs: a four-year B.Tech in
Computer Science & Engineering (sanctioned intake 300), a B.Tech in Computer Science & Design (CSD, sanctioned intake 60), a B.Tech in AI & ML (sanctioned intake 240), and a B.Tech in CSE (IoT, Cyber Security & Blockchain Technology, sanctioned intake 60), alongside a postgraduate program: a two-year M.Tech in Computer Science & Technology. These programs are designed to produce industry-ready professionals with deep fundamentals, design thinking, and strong ethical practice.

### Message from Head of the Department  
Dr. Bh. V. S. Rama Krishnam Raju
Professor & Head of the Department
Welcome to the Department of Computer Science & Engineering
Since its inception in 1991, the CSE Department at SRKR Engineering College has evolved into a premier destination for computer science education. We are committed to providing a high-quality, vibrant learning environment backed by state-of-the-art laboratories and smart classrooms. Our curriculum builds strong foundations in core computing while offering robust exposure to emerging technologies like AI, Machine Learning, Cyber Security, and Cloud Computing. Recognized as a Research Centre by JNTU Kakinada, the department offers M.Tech and doctoral programs, actively driving innovation through industry partnerships, hackathons, and project-based learning. Nurtured by student professional bodies, our graduates excel in global placements, emerging as competent, ethical, and socially responsible engineers. I invite you to join us on this journey of learning, innovation, and excellence.
#### Vision
* To envision a diverse, stimulating, continually improving academic and research environment to fulfill the needs of the society and to mould students as socially responsible and competent professionals in the field of computer science and engineering.
#### Mission
* To provide a strong theoretical and practical background across the computer science and engineering discipline with an emphasis on software development.
* To impart modern technologies with industrial, academic and research collaboration.
* To inculcate professional behaviour, strong ethical values, leadership abilities and impart the skills necessary to continue education for professional growth.

### About the Department
Established in 1991, the Department of Computer Science and Engineering has grown from an initial intake of 40 students into a premier academic and research hub with a current B.Tech (CSE) intake of 300. Recognized as a Research Centre by JNTU Kakinada since 2019, the department also offers an M.Tech program in Computer Science and Technology. Supported by experienced faculty, specialized laboratories, E-classrooms, and ICT-enabled infrastructure, the department provides a dynamic and student-centric learning environment.
The curriculum is aligned with global technological trends and AICTE guidelines, offering specializations in AI/ML and IoT, along with Honors and Minor programs. Strong industry collaborations with organizations such as TCS iON, Netenrich, and Bennett University enhance practical exposure and employability. The department consistently achieves excellent placement records with top salary packages. Professional bodies like ISTE and the Association of Computer Engineers (ACE) further promote technical, co-curricular, and leadership excellence among students.

## Key Milestones
From a modest beginning in 1991 to a 300-seat program with NBA accreditation, a JNTUK Research Centre, and active industry partnerships, the Department of CSE has continuously evolved to meet the demands of modern computing.  
#### [1991](#)
Department of Computer Science & Engineering established with an initial B.Tech intake of 40.  
#### [2006](#)
Launched M.Tech in Computer Science & Technology (CST), strengthening postgraduate research.  
#### [2019](#)
Recognised as a Research Centre by JNTU Kakinada, opening doors to formal Ph.D. supervision.  
#### [Today](#)
B.Tech intake of 300, NBA-accredited, with AI/ML & IoT specialisations and global industry tie-ups.

### Message from Head of the Department  
Dr. Bh. V. S. Rama Krishnam Raju
Professor & Head of the Department
Welcome to the Department of Computer Science & Engineering
Since its inception in 1991, the CSE Department at SRKR Engineering College has evolved into a premier destination for computer science education. We are committed to providing a high-quality, vibrant learning environment backed by state-of-the-art laboratories and smart classrooms. Our curriculum builds strong foundations in core computing while offering robust exposure to emerging technologies like AI, Machine Learning, Cyber Security, and Cloud Computing. Recognized as a Research Centre by JNTU Kakinada, the department offers M.Tech and doctoral programs, actively driving innovation through industry partnerships, hackathons, and project-based learning. Nurtured by student professional bodies, our graduates excel in global placements, emerging as competent, ethical, and socially responsible engineers. I invite you to join us on this journey of learning, innovation, and excellence.
#### Vision
* To envision a diverse, stimulating, continually improving academic and research environment to fulfill the needs of the society and to mould students as socially responsible and competent professionals in the field of computer science and engineering.
#### Mission
* To provide a strong theoretical and practical background across the computer science and engineering discipline with an emphasis on software development.
* To impart modern technologies with industrial, academic and research collaboration.
* To inculcate professional behaviour, strong ethical values, leadership abilities and impart the skills necessary to continue education for professional growth.

### About the Department
Established in 1991, the Department of Computer Science and Engineering has grown from an initial intake of 40 students into a premier academic and research hub with a current B.Tech (CSE) intake of 300. Recognized as a Research Centre by JNTU Kakinada since 2019, the department also offers an M.Tech program in Computer Science and Technology. Supported by experienced faculty, specialized laboratories, E-classrooms, and ICT-enabled infrastructure, the department provides a dynamic and student-centric learning environment.
The curriculum is aligned with global technological trends and AICTE guidelines, offering specializations in AI/ML and IoT, along with Honors and Minor programs. Strong industry collaborations with organizations such as TCS iON, Netenrich, and Bennett University enhance practical exposure and employability. The department consistently achieves excellent placement records with top salary packages. Professional bodies like ISTE and the Association of Computer Engineers (ACE) further promote technical, co-curricular, and leadership excellence among students.

## Key Milestones
From a modest beginning in 1991 to a 300-seat program with NBA accreditation, a JNTUK Research Centre, and active industry partnerships, the Department of CSE has continuously evolved to meet the demands of modern computing.  
#### [1991](#)
Department of Computer Science & Engineering established with an initial B.Tech intake of 40.  
#### [2006](#)
Launched M.Tech in Computer Science & Technology (CST), strengthening postgraduate research.  
#### [2019](#)
Recognised as a Research Centre by JNTU Kakinada, opening doors to formal Ph.D. supervision.  
#### [Today](#)
B.Tech intake of 300, NBA-accredited, with AI/ML & IoT specialisations and global industry tie-ups.

I am the academic advisor for **Sagi Rama Krishnam Raju Engineering College (SRKREC)**, located in Bhimavaram, Andhra Pradesh. The provided records do not contain information regarding "Sri Sairam College of Engineering."

However, I can provide detailed, verified information about **SRKREC**, which is the institution I represent. Below are the key details regarding our campus infrastructure, facilities, and academic standing based on our official records.

### Institutional Profile & Accreditation

*   **Establishment:** Founded in **1980**.
*   **Location:** Spread across **30 acres** in Bhimavaram, Andhra Pradesh.
*   **Accreditations & Recognition:**
    *   **NAAC A+** Accreditation.
    *   **NBA** Recognition across six programmes.
    *   **SIRO** (Scientific and Industrial Research Organization) status from **DSIR**.
*   **Academic Offerings:** The college offers **12 B.Tech. programmes**.
*   **Research & Innovation:**
    *   Home to **18 Centres of Excellence** dedicated to cutting-edge research in core and frontier areas.
    *   Features a **Technology Incubation Centre** that supports student startups, with special arrangements for SC/ST students supported by AICTE.

### Infrastructure & Learning Facilities

The campus is designed to support effective pedagogical practices with state-of-the-art infrastructure compliant with guidelines from **UGC**, **AICTE**, and **JNTU Kakinada**.

#### Academic Spaces
*   **Classrooms:** **106** classrooms and seminar halls are equipped with **ICT-enabled facilities**.
*   **Laboratories:** **77 laboratories** fully equipped with the latest equipment as per curriculum and research requirements.
*   **Specialized Halls:**
    *   **8** Seminar Halls
    *   **5** Drawing Halls
    *   **7** Workshops
    *   **3** Computer Centers
*   **Accessibility:** Ramps, lifts, and separate restrooms with western toilets are available to facilitate differently abled students.

#### IT & Computational Resources
The institution provides adequate computing facilities for faculty and students to promote an effective Teaching-Learning Process (TLP).

| Resource Category | Quantity/Specification |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Computers** | **2,393** |
| **Printers** | **95** |
| **Internet Bandwidth** | Over **1,000 Mbps** |
| **WiFi Access Points** | **63** secured connectivity points covering the whole campus |
| **Servers** | **12** |
| **Software** | **12** Legal System Software, **31** Legal Application Software |

### Cultural, Sports & Wellness Facilities

SRKREC encourages participation in sports, games, and cultural activities as a regular practice since its inception.

#### Cultural Activities
*   **Auditoriums:** Two auditoriums are available for cultural programs:
    *   One **Open Auditorium**.
    *   One **Air-Conditioned Auditorium**.
*   **Performance Space:** The open terrace on the top of the **CSE building** is specially allotted for practicing and performing various cultural activities.

#### Sports & Games
*   **Playground:** An open playground of **29,546.48 sq.mt** is utilized for various games.
*   **Sports Offered:** Football, Kabaddi, Handball, Tennis, Basketball, and Cricket.
*   **Gymnasiums:** The college has **2 Gymnasiums** equipped with all required exercise equipment.
    *   One gymnasium is exclusively for **girl students and women faculty**.

#### Yoga & Wellness
*   **PAIE Cell:** The **People Association for Inner Engineering (PAIE)** Cell was established in **2016** to organize and monitor yoga activities for the wellbeing of students and faculty.
*   **Practice Areas:** Daily yoga practice sessions are accommodated in the auditorium and other convenient open places on campus.

### Financial Commitment to Infrastructure
*   **Expenditure:** The institution invested **₹672.52 Lakhs** in infrastructure augmentation (excluding salary) during the 2022-23 academic year.

### Message from Head of the Department  
Dr. Bh. V. S. Rama Krishnam Raju
Professor & Head of the Department
Welcome to the Department of Computer Science & Engineering
Since its inception in 1991, the CSE Department at SRKR Engineering College has evolved into a premier destination for computer science education. We are committed to providing a high-quality, vibrant learning environment backed by state-of-the-art laboratories and smart classrooms. Our curriculum builds strong foundations in core computing while offering robust exposure to emerging technologies like AI, Machine Learning, Cyber Security, and Cloud Computing. Recognized as a Research Centre by JNTU Kakinada, the department offers M.Tech and doctoral programs, actively driving innovation through industry partnerships, hackathons, and project-based learning. Nurtured by student professional bodies, our graduates excel in global placements, emerging as competent, ethical, and socially responsible engineers. I invite you to join us on this journey of learning, innovation, and excellence.
#### Vision
* To envision a diverse, stimulating, continually improving academic and research environment to fulfill the needs of the society and to mould students as socially responsible and competent professionals in the field of computer science and engineering.
#### Mission
* To provide a strong theoretical and practical background across the computer science and engineering discipline with an emphasis on software development.
* To impart modern technologies with industrial, academic and research collaboration.
* To inculcate professional behaviour, strong ethical values, leadership abilities and impart the skills necessary to continue education for professional growth.

JNTUK-affiliated undergraduate programs: a four-year B.Tech in

### Message from Head of the Department  
Dr. Bh. V. S. Rama Krishnam Raju
Professor & Head of the Department
Welcome to the Department of Computer Science & Engineering
Since its inception in 1991, the CSE Department at SRKR Engineering College has evolved into a premier destination for computer science education. We are committed to providing a high-quality, vibrant learning environment backed by state-of-the-art laboratories and smart classrooms. Our curriculum builds strong foundations in core computing while offering robust exposure to emerging technologies like AI, Machine Learning, Cyber Security, and Cloud Computing. Recognized as a Research Centre by JNTU Kakinada, the department offers M.Tech and doctoral programs, actively driving innovation through industry partnerships, hackathons, and project-based learning. Nurtured by student professional bodies, our graduates excel in global placements, emerging as competent, ethical, and socially responsible engineers. I invite you to join us on this journey of learning, innovation, and excellence.
#### Vision
* To envision a diverse, stimulating, continually improving academic and research environment to fulfill the needs of the society and to mould students as socially responsible and competent professionals in the field of computer science and engineering.
#### Mission
* To provide a strong theoretical and practical background across the computer science and engineering discipline with an emphasis on software development.
* To impart modern technologies with industrial, academic and research collaboration.
* To inculcate professional behaviour, strong ethical values, leadership abilities and impart the skills necessary to continue education for professional growth.

# Academic Programs

#### Programs Offered
The Department of Computer Science & Engineering offers four
JNTUK-affiliated undergraduate programs: a four-year B.Tech in
Computer Science & Engineering (sanctioned intake 300), a B.Tech in Computer Science & Design (CSD, sanctioned intake 60), a B.Tech in AI & ML (sanctioned intake 240), and a B.Tech in CSE (IoT, Cyber Security & Blockchain Technology, sanctioned intake 60), alongside a postgraduate program: a two-year M.Tech in Computer Science & Technology. These programs are designed to produce industry-ready professionals with deep fundamentals, design thinking, and strong ethical practice.

### Message from Head of the Department  
Dr. Bh. V. S. Rama Krishnam Raju
Professor & Head of the Department
Welcome to the Department of Computer Science & Engineering
Since its inception in 1991, the CSE Department at SRKR Engineering College has evolved into a premier destination for computer science education. We are committed to providing a high-quality, vibrant learning environment backed by state-of-the-art laboratories and smart classrooms. Our curriculum builds strong foundations in core computing while offering robust exposure to emerging technologies like AI, Machine Learning, Cyber Security, and Cloud Computing. Recognized as a Research Centre by JNTU Kakinada, the department offers M.Tech and doctoral programs, actively driving innovation through industry partnerships, hackathons, and project-based learning. Nurtured by student professional bodies, our graduates excel in global placements, emerging as competent, ethical, and socially responsible engineers. I invite you to join us on this journey of learning, innovation, and excellence.
#### Vision
* To envision a diverse, stimulating, continually improving academic and research environment to fulfill the needs of the society and to mould students as socially responsible and competent professionals in the field of computer science and engineering.
#### Mission
* To provide a strong theoretical and practical background across the computer science and engineering discipline with an emphasis on software development.
* To impart modern technologies with industrial, academic and research collaboration.
* To inculcate professional behaviour, strong ethical values, leadership abilities and impart the skills necessary to continue education for professional growth.

I am the academic advisor for **Sagi Rama Krishnam Raju Engineering College (SRKREC)**, located in Bhimavaram, Andhra Pradesh. The provided records do not contain information regarding "Sri Sairam College of Engineering."

However, I can provide detailed, verified information about **SRKREC**, which is the institution I represent. Below are the key details regarding our campus infrastructure, facilities, and academic standing based on our official records.

### Institutional Profile & Accreditation

*   **Establishment:** Founded in **1980**.
*   **Location:** Spread across **30 acres** in Bhimavaram, Andhra Pradesh.
*   **Accreditations & Recognition:**
    *   **NAAC A+** Accreditation.
    *   **NBA** Recognition across six programmes.
    *   **SIRO** (Scientific and Industrial Research Organization) status from **DSIR**.
*   **Academic Offerings:** The college offers **12 B.Tech. programmes**.
*   **Research & Innovation:**
    *   Home to **18 Centres of Excellence** dedicated to cutting-edge research in core and frontier areas.
    *   Features a **Technology Incubation Centre** that supports student startups, with special arrangements for SC/ST students supported by AICTE.

### Infrastructure & Learning Facilities

The campus is designed to support effective pedagogical practices with state-of-the-art infrastructure compliant with guidelines from **UGC**, **AICTE**, and **JNTU Kakinada**.

#### Academic Spaces
*   **Classrooms:** **106** classrooms and seminar halls are equipped with **ICT-enabled facilities**.
*   **Laboratories:** **77 laboratories** fully equipped with the latest equipment as per curriculum and research requirements.
*   **Specialized Halls:**
    *   **8** Seminar Halls
    *   **5** Drawing Halls
    *   **7** Workshops
    *   **3** Computer Centers
*   **Accessibility:** Ramps, lifts, and separate restrooms with western toilets are available to facilitate differently abled students.

#### IT & Computational Resources
The institution provides adequate computing facilities for faculty and students to promote an effective Teaching-Learning Process (TLP).

| Resource Category | Quantity/Specification |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Computers** | **2,393** |
| **Printers** | **95** |
| **Internet Bandwidth** | Over **1,000 Mbps** |
| **WiFi Access Points** | **63** secured connectivity points covering the whole campus |
| **Servers** | **12** |
| **Software** | **12** Legal System Software, **31** Legal Application Software |

### Cultural, Sports & Wellness Facilities

SRKREC encourages participation in sports, games, and cultural activities as a regular practice since its inception.

#### Cultural Activities
*   **Auditoriums:** Two auditoriums are available for cultural programs:
    *   One **Open Auditorium**.
    *   One **Air-Conditioned Auditorium**.
*   **Performance Space:** The open terrace on the top of the **CSE building** is specially allotted for practicing and performing various cultural activities.

#### Sports & Games
*   **Playground:** An open playground of **29,546.48 sq.mt** is utilized for various games.
*   **Sports Offered:** Football, Kabaddi, Handball, Tennis, Basketball, and Cricket.
*   **Gymnasiums:** The college has **2 Gymnasiums** equipped with all required exercise equipment.
    *   One gymnasium is exclusively for **girl students and women faculty**.

#### Yoga & Wellness
*   **PAIE Cell:** The **People Association for Inner Engineering (PAIE)** Cell was established in **2016** to organize and monitor yoga activities for the wellbeing of students and faculty.
*   **Practice Areas:** Daily yoga practice sessions are accommodated in the auditorium and other convenient open places on campus.

### Financial Commitment to Infrastructure
*   **Expenditure:** The institution invested **₹672.52 Lakhs** in infrastructure augmentation (excluding salary) during the 2022-23 academic year.

For specific queries regarding admissions, departmental contacts, or further academic details, please visit the official SRKREC website or contact the respective departmental offices on campus.

### Message from Head of the Department  
Dr. Bh. V. S. Rama Krishnam Raju
Professor & Head of the Department
Welcome to the Department of Computer Science & Engineering
Since its inception in 1991, the CSE Department at SRKR Engineering College has evolved into a premier destination for computer science education. We are committed to providing a high-quality, vibrant learning environment backed by state-of-the-art laboratories and smart classrooms. Our curriculum builds strong foundations in core computing while offering robust exposure to emerging technologies like AI, Machine Learning, Cyber Security, and Cloud Computing. Recognized as a Research Centre by JNTU Kakinada, the department offers M.Tech and doctoral programs, actively driving innovation through industry partnerships, hackathons, and project-based learning. Nurtured by student professional bodies, our graduates excel in global placements, emerging as competent, ethical, and socially responsible engineers. I invite you to join us on this journey of learning, innovation, and excellence.
#### Vision
* To envision a diverse, stimulating, continually improving academic and research environment to fulfill the needs of the society and to mould students as socially responsible and competent professionals in the field of computer science and engineering.
#### Mission
* To provide a strong theoretical and practical background across the computer science and engineering discipline with an emphasis on software development.
* To impart modern technologies with industrial, academic and research collaboration.
* To inculcate professional behaviour, strong ethical values, leadership abilities and impart the skills necessary to continue education for professional growth.

* To impart modern technologies with industrial, academic and research collaboration.
* To inculcate professional behaviour, strong ethical values, leadership abilities and impart the skills necessary to continue education for professional growth.

### Message from Head of the Department  
Dr. Bh. V. S. Rama Krishnam Raju
Professor & Head of the Department
Welcome to the Department of Computer Science & Engineering
Since its inception in 1991, the CSE Department at SRKR Engineering College has evolved into a premier destination for computer science education. We are committed to providing a high-quality, vibrant learning environment backed by state-of-the-art laboratories and smart classrooms. Our curriculum builds strong foundations in core computing while offering robust exposure to emerging technologies like AI, Machine Learning, Cyber Security, and Cloud Computing. Recognized as a Research Centre by JNTU Kakinada, the department offers M.Tech and doctoral programs, actively driving innovation through industry partnerships, hackathons, and project-based learning. Nurtured by student professional bodies, our graduates excel in global placements, emerging as competent, ethical, and socially responsible engineers. I invite you to join us on this journey of learning, innovation, and excellence.
#### Vision
* To envision a diverse, stimulating, continually improving academic and research environment to fulfill the needs of the society and to mould students as socially responsible and competent professionals in the field of computer science and engineering.
#### Mission
* To provide a strong theoretical and practical background across the computer science and engineering discipline with an emphasis on software development.
* To impart modern technologies with industrial, academic and research collaboration.
* To inculcate professional behaviour, strong ethical values, leadership abilities and impart the skills necessary to continue education for professional growth.

JNTUK-affiliated undergraduate programs: a four-year B.Tech in

### Message from Head of the Department  
Dr. Bh. V. S. Rama Krishnam Raju
Professor & Head of the Department
Welcome to the Department of Computer Science & Engineering
Since its inception in 1991, the CSE Department at SRKR Engineering College has evolved into a premier destination for computer science education. We are committed to providing a high-quality, vibrant learning environment backed by state-of-the-art laboratories and smart classrooms. Our curriculum builds strong foundations in core computing while offering robust exposure to emerging technologies like AI, Machine Learning, Cyber Security, and Cloud Computing. Recognized as a Research Centre by JNTU Kakinada, the department offers M.Tech and doctoral programs, actively driving innovation through industry partnerships, hackathons, and project-based learning. Nurtured by student professional bodies, our graduates excel in global placements, emerging as competent, ethical, and socially responsible engineers. I invite you to join us on this journey of learning, innovation, and excellence.
#### Vision
* To envision a diverse, stimulating, continually improving academic and research environment to fulfill the needs of the society and to mould students as socially responsible and competent professionals in the field of computer science and engineering.
#### Mission
* To provide a strong theoretical and practical background across the computer science and engineering discipline with an emphasis on software development.
* To impart modern technologies with industrial, academic and research collaboration.
* To inculcate professional behaviour, strong ethical values, leadership abilities and impart the skills necessary to continue education for professional growth.

# Academic Programs
CSE / Academic Programs
Navigate  
#### Programs Offered
The Department of Computer Science & Engineering offers four
JNTUK-affiliated undergraduate programs: a four-year B.Tech in
Computer Science & Engineering (sanctioned intake 300), a B.Tech in Computer Science & Design (CSD, sanctioned intake 60), a B.Tech in AI & ML (sanctioned intake 240), and a B.Tech in CSE (IoT, Cyber Security & Blockchain Technology, sanctioned intake 60), alongside a postgraduate program: a two-year M.Tech in Computer Science & Technology. These programs are designed to produce industry-ready professionals with deep fundamentals, design thinking, and strong ethical practice.

### Message from Head of the Department  
Dr. Bh. V. S. Rama Krishnam Raju
Professor & Head of the Department
Welcome to the Department of Computer Science & Engineering
Since its inception in 1991, the CSE Department at SRKR Engineering College has evolved into a premier destination for computer science education. We are committed to providing a high-quality, vibrant learning environment backed by state-of-the-art laboratories and smart classrooms. Our curriculum builds strong foundations in core computing while offering robust exposure to emerging technologies like AI, Machine Learning, Cyber Security, and Cloud Computing. Recognized as a Research Centre by JNTU Kakinada, the department offers M.Tech and doctoral programs, actively driving innovation through industry partnerships, hackathons, and project-based learning. Nurtured by student professional bodies, our graduates excel in global placements, emerging as competent, ethical, and socially responsible engineers. I invite you to join us on this journey of learning, innovation, and excellence.
#### Vision
* To envision a diverse, stimulating, continually improving academic and research environment to fulfill the needs of the society and to mould students as socially responsible and competent professionals in the field of computer science and engineering.
#### Mission
* To provide a strong theoretical and practical background across the computer science and engineering discipline with an emphasis on software development.
* To impart modern technologies with industrial, academic and research collaboration.
* To inculcate professional behaviour, strong ethical values, leadership abilities and impart the skills necessary to continue education for professional growth.

# Academic Programs
CSE / Academic Programs
Navigate  
#### Programs Offered
The Department of Computer Science & Engineering offers four
JNTUK-affiliated undergraduate programs: a four-year B.Tech in
Computer Science & Engineering (sanctioned intake 300), a B.Tech in Computer Science & Design (CSD, sanctioned intake 60), a B.Tech in AI & ML (sanctioned intake 240), and a B.Tech in CSE (IoT, Cyber Security & Blockchain Technology, sanctioned intake 60), alongside a postgraduate program: a two-year M.Tech in Computer Science & Technology. These programs are designed to produce industry-ready professionals with deep fundamentals, design thinking, and strong ethical practice.

### Message from Head of the Department  
Dr. Bh. V. S. Rama Krishnam Raju
Professor & Head of the Department
Welcome to the Department of Computer Science & Engineering
Since its inception in 1991, the CSE Department at SRKR Engineering College has evolved into a premier destination for computer science education. We are committed to providing a high-quality, vibrant learning environment backed by state-of-the-art laboratories and smart classrooms. Our curriculum builds strong foundations in core computing while offering robust exposure to emerging technologies like AI, Machine Learning, Cyber Security, and Cloud Computing. Recognized as a Research Centre by JNTU Kakinada, the department offers M.Tech and doctoral programs, actively driving innovation through industry partnerships, hackathons, and project-based learning. Nurtured by student professional bodies, our graduates excel in global placements, emerging as competent, ethical, and socially responsible engineers. I invite you to join us on this journey of learning, innovation, and excellence.
#### Vision
* To envision a diverse, stimulating, continually improving academic and research environment to fulfill the needs of the society and to mould students as socially responsible and competent professionals in the field of computer science and engineering.
#### Mission
* To provide a strong theoretical and practical background across the computer science and engineering discipline with an emphasis on software development.
* To impart modern technologies with industrial, academic and research collaboration.
* To inculcate professional behaviour, strong ethical values, leadership abilities and impart the skills necessary to continue education for professional growth.

I am the academic advisor for **Sagi Rama Krishnam Raju Engineering College (SRKREC)**, located in Bhimavaram, Andhra Pradesh. The provided records do not contain information regarding "Sri Sairam College of Engineering."

However, I can provide detailed, verified information about **SRKREC**, which is the institution I represent. Below are the key details regarding our campus infrastructure, facilities, and academic standing based on our official records.

### Institutional Profile & Accreditation

*   **Establishment:** Founded in **1980**.
*   **Location:** Spread across **30 acres** in Bhimavaram, Andhra Pradesh.
*   **Accreditations & Recognition:**
    *   **NAAC A+** Accreditation.
    *   **NBA** Recognition across six programmes.
    *   **SIRO** (Scientific and Industrial Research Organization) status from **DSIR**.
*   **Academic Offerings:** The college offers **12 B.Tech. programmes**.
*   **Research & Innovation:**
    *   Home to **18 Centres of Excellence** dedicated to cutting-edge research in core and frontier areas.
    *   Features a **Technology Incubation Centre** that supports student startups, with special arrangements for SC/ST students supported by AICTE.

### Infrastructure & Learning Facilities

The campus is designed to support effective pedagogical practices with state-of-the-art infrastructure compliant with guidelines from **UGC**, **AICTE**, and **JNTU Kakinada**.

#### Academic Spaces
*   **Classrooms:** **106** classrooms and seminar halls are equipped with **ICT-enabled facilities**.
*   **Laboratories:** **77 laboratories** fully equipped with the latest equipment as per curriculum and research requirements.
*   **Specialized Halls:**
    *   **8** Seminar Halls
    *   **5** Drawing Halls
    *   **7** Workshops
    *   **3** Computer Centers
*   **Accessibility:** Ramps, lifts, and separate restrooms with western toilets are available to facilitate differently abled students.

#### IT & Computational Resources
The institution provides adequate computing facilities for faculty and students to promote an effective Teaching-Learning Process (TLP).

| Resource Category | Quantity/Specification |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Computers** | **2,393** |
| **Printers** | **95** |
| **Internet Bandwidth** | Over **1,000 Mbps** |
| **WiFi Access Points** | **63** secured connectivity points covering the whole campus |
| **Servers** | **12** |
| **Software** | **12** Legal System Software, **31** Legal Application Software |

### Cultural, Sports & Wellness Facilities

SRKREC encourages participation in sports, games, and cultural activities as a regular practice since its inception.

#### Cultural Activities
*   **Auditoriums:** Two auditoriums are available for cultural programs:
    *   One **Open Auditorium**.
    *   One **Air-Conditioned Auditorium**.
*   **Performance Space:** The open terrace on the top of the **CSE building** is specially allotted for practicing and performing various cultural activities.

#### Sports & Games
*   **Playground:** An open playground of **29,546.48 sq.mt** is utilized for various games.
*   **Sports Offered:** Football, Kabaddi, Handball, Tennis, Basketball, and Cricket.
*   **Gymnasiums:** The college has **2 Gymnasiums** equipped with all required exercise equipment.
    *   One gymnasium is exclusively for **girl students and women faculty**.

#### Yoga & Wellness
*   **PAIE Cell:** The **People Association for Inner Engineering (PAIE)** Cell was established in **2016** to organize and monitor yoga activities for the wellbeing of students and faculty.
*   **Practice Areas:** Daily yoga practice sessions are accommodated in the auditorium and other convenient open places on campus.

### Financial Commitment to Infrastructure
*   **Expenditure:** The institution invested **₹672.52 Lakhs** in infrastructure augmentation (excluding salary) during the 2022-23 academic year.
